messages:
Claire (Sales): Hey team — kicking off POC alignment for FinOpt pilot. Customer needs a 4‑week run, HIPAA scope, VPC + model pinning. Need to lock success criteria, SE/eng coverage, and answer pricing/security Qs. Who can help scope?
Aisha (AM): I got the initial questionnaire from them — it's the standard HIPAA + data residency asks. I'll upload to the shared drive. Can we confirm who owns the security responses? @security-bot?
security-bot: Assigned review to @Marco (Eng) and @Jared (SE). Please expect the questionnaire link in #legal later today.
Jared (SE): I can take infra + integration answers. Quick note on resourcing: estimate 8 SE hours/week for weeks 0–2 (deploy + tuning), then 3–4 hrs/week for monitoring/rollout in weeks 3–4. That covers smoke tests, KV cache config, and prefix caching checks.
Marco (Eng): For performance we should pin a 13B quantized variant on Dedicated or Private VPC. If they insist on hosted with VPC peering, throughput might be limited. Need to confirm expected QPS and 95th p95 latency SLO.
Priya (Sales Eng): Proposed acceptance criteria (suggested):
- Functional: pass 90% of prompt evals on provided test set (we'll co-design prompts)
- Perf: 95th latency <= 300ms for single-turn gen at their median token length
- Reliability: >= 99% uptime during pilot window
- Cost: baseline token cost budget agreed before week 2
Claire (Sales): Love those. Customer also asked about a short pilot discount and whether we can provide an audit log export. Thoughts?
Aisha (AM): Audit logs — yes, we can provide logs from Private/Dedicated. For hosted we can do a limited export depending on retention tier. I'll confirm retention policy.
Priya (Sales Eng): Discount — we can offer 20% usage credit for the pilot if they commit to a purchase convo after pilot. Standard playbook.
Jared (SE): Proposed timeline (high level):
```
Week 0 (kickoff): access + security questionnaire, confirm dataflows, assign contacts
Week 1: infra deploy (VPC/Private), model pin + smoke tests, baseline prompt set collection
Week 2: integration + prompt tuning, KV/prefix cache tuning, run first eval set
Week 3: performance tuning, run full evals, customer UAT sessions
Week 4: acceptance checklist, export logs, handoff to customer success
```
Claire (Sales): That looks good. Can we call out deliverables and owners inline? Example: 
- Security questionnaire — owner: Marco (Eng) / due: EOD Thu
- VPC setup + access — owner: Jared (SE) / due: Mon week 1
- Prompt set + eval harness — owner: Priya / due: Wed week 1
- Usage baseline & pricing note — owner: Claire / due: Fri week 1
Marco (Eng): I'll take the questionnaire. I'll need the customer network diagram and the required CIDR ranges.
Aisha (AM): I'll collect the network info in the doc. Also heads up — their legal asked about SOC2 artifacts. Should we route to solutions legal?
Priya (Sales Eng): Yes, loop in legal. For SOC2 we can provide the standard summary + point them to our compliance page.
Claire (Sales): OK — next steps: Aisha will post questionnaire + network info. Marco + Jared to fill security answers. Priya to draft eval prompt set and quickstarter harness. I'll draft the pricing pilot credit and outreach email to the customer.
Jared (SE): One more ops note — plan a 2‑hour maintenance window for Week 1 deploy; I'll coordinate with eng-sre.
Priya (Sales Eng): :thumbsup: Can we schedule a 30m kickoff with customer + SE on Monday? Prefer morning PT.
Claire (Sales): Scheduling now, sending invites. Thanks all — will update thread with the doc links.
security-bot: Security questionnaire link posted: https://redwood.app/secure/finopt-poc-qnrs (access for participants granted).
